finding.text: The old selector required an ORDINARY fixed placement answered need_placement; the retail case never asked one (the f734 withdrawn_fixed_state succeeded on the same case only because its predicate admits buildings listed under a city). A building listed under a city has CONSUMED its held sub-type-derived collision flag once its placement question yields the final pose.
finding.source_reason: model_host.rs fixed_join: for `of_city` (flag_given, position_given) = (placement_given, true) and the flag is compared with `state.collision_fixed() && !mobile_flag` once given (fixed_flag != expected_fixed -> `[candidate.mirror] the campaign's collision-fixed flag differs from the host's fixed state of the placement`); the join returns BEFORE `candidate_in_store`, which takes the store by shared reference (no UPDATED, terrain, RNG or time). An ordinary fixed candidate has the flag given from its fixed facts and is covered by the same predicate. The real provider's refusal after a sub-type restatement is pinned for an ordinary fixed placement by tests/model_target_point.rs (a_changed_sub_type_changes_the_rule_the_next_question_is_decided_from) and for a listed building its building test pins the SAME comparison in the opposite direction (the campaign flag false against a colliding record: `[candidate.mirror]` ... `collision-fixed` at the placement stage); neither was re-run in this lane (scope was entity_authority only), and no test pins the restated-UNKNOWN direction for a listed building: that is the fact of the native run.

contract.eligible: the campaign's FINAL placement question (placement fact 44 and collision flag fact 8 given, not a city, not mobile, named by the served key, the key held by an acknowledged FIXED_STATE report whose sub type fact 11 is not UNKNOWN) whose UNMODIFIED payload was delegated to the real provider and answered `test` with a final pose of exactly twelve patterns. Counted as fixed_rule_eligible BEFORE anything is changed.
contract.restatement: ONLY that record's sub type is restated as UNKNOWN with the record's current other words (kept from every acknowledged report in BOTH windows, armed and before the launch), to the same provider, and must satisfy scan.fixed.reply_problem: `placed`, the same key, no cursor. A cursor, another key, another state or a provider that fails to answer is fixed_rule_changed = -1, a reply fault with its own verdict, and the payload is NOT re-asked.
contract.extra_evaluation: the SAME payload is asked of the SAME provider once more (scene, depth, kind, definition, key identical). This is a declared extra Host-only evaluation of one actual question across two controlled Host states; it is NOT a question the campaign asked and is not counted as one (candidate_after stays 6).
contract.refusal: the provider's own refusal [candidate.mirror] ... collision-fixed is handed back to the campaign in place of the pose and must be the only fault (request faults 0, reply fault 1). An answer other than a refusal, or a raise, is a failure of the claim and is never a pass.
contract.diagnostic_fields: the four fixed_rule_* row fields keep their names and are still emitted by every mode (zero or empty outside this one); their meaning is declared in the driver header: eligible = final placement questions validated before the change; changed = 1 acknowledged / -1 not; changed_next = "placement" when the re-evaluated payload was the same placement's final placement question (NOT a next campaign question); changed_cause = fixed_rule_mirror_differs when the failure is the mirror refusal. No default or control field was added or changed.
contract.side_effects: the re-evaluation is refused by fixed_join before the narrow phase: no kernel, UPDATED getter, terrain read, random draw, movement step or engine action. The harness asserts the engine, movement, query and pose logs are empty and the placement stayed standing. The floating-point state is untouched because fixed_join is integer-only and runs before any float conversion.
contract.not_claimed: no natural ordinary-sector coverage and no claim that all fifteen sub types are natively proven: a listed building is an ACTUAL required fixed-family consumer of the held flag at that question, one sub type (CITY_BUILDING) in the harness
